label: Additive inbox block rides the existing v1 mirror file; no new transport (atomic 0600 write, 300ms debounce, SSH slices 2s throttle / 60s heartbeat, phone polls 8s)
InboxEvent/InboxNodeNow contract with hard caps: 50-event feed, title<=120, detail<=240, activity<=80, prompt<=120, options<=4x60, monotonic ${ts}-${seq} ids

Event production is stash-priority: fresh AskUserQuestion stash forces question kind regardless of signaled state; pendingId rides approvals only and is stripped from question broadcasts via askKind enrichment
Dedup is TITLE-based and bounded (10-min QUESTION_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS); new asks settle older unresolved asks; loadPersisted restores state+feed so dedup survives restarts (duplicate-APNs field-bug fix)

Lifecycle: resolve-on-leaving-blocked/waiting, archive-on-node-removal, ackDone on read, shared 6h expiry for all events, trimInboxFeed protects newest done + newest unresolved ask past the cap; activity lines from raw PreToolUse hooks power live cards

Quick-approve re-reads the status file before sending keys (only when still blocked, else already-handled); SSH slices keep a node-filtered inbox while dropping settings/usage/server; heartbeat makes stale updatedAt read as no-data
